HYO02NMD0U_C000.title: Napkin
HYO02NMD0U_C000.description: The napkin is unveiled as part of the Le Noël de Monsieur Dior collection. Made in white cotton, the napkin is embroidered with a monogram inspired by Mr. Dior's birth announcement. The iconic design will enhance tables during holiday celebrations.

HYO03MUS0L_C970.title: Embroidered Placemat and Napkin Set
HYO03MUS0L_C970.description: Dior Maison unveils new designs for the Lily of the Valley collection with a subtle homage to the founding couturier's lucky flower. Inspired by the eponymous dress created by Mr. Dior for the Spring-Summer 1957 Haute Couture Fashion Show, delicate, embossed bell-shaped flowers accent a set of sophisticated creations, including glasses, candles and even table linens. Continuing this pastoral poetry, a selection of glassware pieces is enhanced by four-leaf clovers or engraved with lilies of the valley, in a bucolic ode to Christian Dior's passion for superstition. As a final surprise, elegant palm tree and ladybug ceramic candle holders, available in green and white, complete this exceptional selection. The refined collection suggests a springtime getaway and sunny days to come. *These objects of desire were developed in collaboration with the Jean Roger workshop.
HYO03MUS0L_C970.characteristics:
100% linen
This set contains a placemat and a napkin
Made in France

HYO03ALV0U_C700.title: Embroidered Placemat
HYO03ALV0U_C700.description: Having inherited a passion for flowers from my mother, I especially enjoyed the company of plants and gardeners, Christian Dior confided in his memoirs. Adorned with designs of lily of the valley, the couturier's lucky charm, the Lily of the Valley tableware line is enhanced by new wicker pieces — like placemats, baskets, frames and boxes — decorated with sprigs of the flower.

HYN01CSI0L_C970.title: Set of Four Hand Towels
HYN01CSI0L_C970.description: The set of four hand towels is unveiled as part of Cordelia de Castellane's Les Gris-Gris de Monsieur Dior collection. Crafted in white cotton, each towel is delicately embroidered with the star, clover, bee or rose, Christian Dior's treasured symbols and lucky charms, celebrating his passion for superstition and the art of living. The design will enhance any home with the House's iconic codes and can be coordinated with other creations from the collection for a poetic and joyous atmosphere.
